title: Integrated transcriptomic and machine learning analysis reveals novel diagnostic biomarkers for adolescent major depressive disorder.
summary: In 15 adolescents with MDD and 15 matched controls, transcriptomic feature selection produced a three-gene diagnostic panel (AUC 0.867); hub-gene expression was additionally examined by RT-qPCR/ELISA. The small single-center sample makes the diagnostic estimate preliminary. The result is reported in Frontiers in Psychiatry. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: LASSO, SVM-RFE and Random Forest are used to select candidate diagnostic biomarkers from transcriptomic features
